findings: THE ENTITY HELD. 'The Luddite Lab Resource Hub provides resources for unions, labor organizations, and worker-organizers fighting AI and automation at work' is the record's quote, composed at its own grain; the case studies, primers and library are the hub's sections. Checked 2026-10-29 against the Labor Vector census record of the same day and the sources it saved.
THE HOMONYM KEPT APART. Luddite Labs, the developer-tools company (card 6), is named as unrelated; the record had no disambiguation for it.

THE LEADERSHIP RAISED. 'Founded and co-led by figures including sociologist and DAIR director Alex Hanna': the hub's About page, saved with the record, lists her on the team as 'Director of Research, DAIR Institute' and names no founder; the founding is the composition's, on the LinkedIn card of her launch post. The primer's reframing of displacement as 'a management choice' rests on the AI Weekly card; the record does not carry it.
THE LIBRARY'S OWN SELECTION UNSAID. The record's limit, that the library picks actionable organizing tools and 'typically shies away from general statements of principles', is not composed.

read.notes: Founder: DAIR bound as the maker ('a project by the Distributed AI Research Institute (DAIR)'), the records' 'a project of'. 'Founded and co-led by figures including sociologist and DAIR director Alex Hanna' goes beyond the records: they list Alex Hanna on the team as 'Director of Research, DAIR Institute' and state no founder; not charged (DAIR is the founder token and is present). Commitments present but thin: public access ('The public resource hub'), the records' 'a publicly accessible resource'; the © DAIR all-rights-reserved terms and the library's selection rule are not carried. Deposit chain absent: the access offer is made through a link whose anchor is the hub's own name, which never fills a second atom, and the site labor.dair-institute.org is not named. 'Core Philosophy: Reframes AI job displacement ... as a management choice' comes from the AI Weekly card about a primer; the primers were not saved, so it is neither credited nor charged. No inversion: the 'Luddite' name is not turned against the hub. No standing substitution.
